# Teqtivity

> > Teqtivity is an IT Asset Management (ITAM) platform that enables organizations to optimize asset lifecycles, track inventory, manage compliance, and automate workflows across hardware and device ecosystems.

Teqtivity provides comprehensive ITAM software serving startups through enterprises across industries including financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, education, and technology. The platform integrates with leading MDM solutions (Jamf, Kandji, Intune), HR systems, and IT tools (ServiceNow, Jira, Okta, Slack) to streamline asset tracking, lifecycle management, and compliance reporting.

## Key Topics

- IT Asset Management (ITAM)
- Asset Tracking & Inventory
- Mobile Device Management (MDM)
- Asset Lifecycle Management
- Workflow Automation
- Compliance & Security
- Onboarding/Offboarding
- Dashboards & Reporting
- MDM Integrations (Jamf, Kandji, Intune)
- Cost Optimization
- Device Management
- Inventory Management
- IT Operations
- Automation
- Enterprise Integration

## Core Platform

- [IT Asset Management Tracking Software & Services](https://www.teqtivity.com/it-asset-management): Main ITAM product page with asset tracking, MDM integration, and lifecycle management
- [Product Tour](https://www.teqtivity.com/product-tour): Interactive product tour showcasing features, pricing tiers, and MDM integrations
- [What is IT Asset Management?](https://www.teqtivity.com/what-is-it-asset-management): Educational guide on ITAM concepts, licensing compliance, and asset lifecycle

## Core Features

- [IT Asset Lifecycle Management Software](https://www.teqtivity.com/lifecycle-management): Asset lifecycle management with workflow automation and end-of-life workflows
- [IT Asset Inventory Management Software & System](https://www.teqtivity.com/inventory-management): Inventory management solution with cycle counting, vendor integration, and analytics
- [Simplify Employee Onboarding & Offboarding Process](https://www.teqtivity.com/onboarding-offboarding): Employee onboarding/offboarding with device tracking and workflow automation
- [Asset Management Dashboards & Reporting](https://www.teqtivity.com/dashboards-reports): Real-time dashboards and custom reporting with MDM device integrations
- [Asset Protection with Compliance & Security](https://www.teqtivity.com/compliance-security): Compliance, security, audit trails, and legal hold for asset data protection

## Solutions by Organization Size

- [Start Up](https://www.teqtivity.com/start-up): Startup-focused ITAM solution with MDM integration and cost optimization
- [Mid Size](https://www.teqtivity.com/mid-size): Mid-market ITAM solution with API integration and compliance reporting
- [Enterprise](https://www.teqtivity.com/enterprise): Enterprise ITAM with hardware inventory, API integration, and HR connectivity

## Industry Solutions

- [Financial Services](https://www.teqtivity.com/financial-services): Financial services industry ITAM solution with compliance and asset tracking
- [Healthcare](https://www.teqtivity.com/healthcare): Healthcare ITAM with medical device management and maintenance automation
- [Manufacturing](https://www.teqtivity.com/manufacturing): Manufacturing ITAM for uptime optimization and production operation efficiency
- [Education](https://www.teqtivity.com/education): Education sector solution with MDM, Jamf/Kandji integration, and device management
- [Construction](https://www.teqtivity.com/construction): Construction industry asset management with equipment monitoring and automation
- [Tech](https://www.teqtivity.com/tech): Tech industry ITAM with ServiceNow, Jira, Okta integrations and automation

## Solutions by Department

- [Help Desk](https://www.teqtivity.com/help-desk): Help desk ITAM with ticketing integration, MDM, and workflow automation
- [Business Teams](https://www.teqtivity.com/business-teams): Cross-functional business teams asset management for collaboration and compliance
